rows.text: Some #WPBL news: San Francisco manager Matt Williams confirms that Kelsie Whitmore will start tomorrow for the Firebells against Los Angeles.

rows.text: NEW: Both Luka Garza and Amari Williams could see increased minutes vs the Hawks, as Neemias Queta finally takes a night off with an illness he's been dealing with since Friday.

rows.text: Celtics two-way players Amari Williams and Ron Harper Jr are both hurt, while Chris Boucher is sidelined with an illness.
